dims: Clear in front of study door ≈ 900
info: Plan B (9 Nov layout). Changes: hall cabinets removed – the zone is now a lounge (set back to keep a ~900 mm clear path to the study door) with a backlit onyx feature wall, two lounge chairs, side table, sculpture, round rug, dome cove ceiling and pendant cluster. New entrance partition sits in line with the household-shelter wall face (x 2080–2600), freestanding with a shadow gap – nothing fixed to the shelter. Kitchen: closed or open version; open keeps the stove-side top cabinets with a ducted hood, tall units at the yard end, a counter facing dining and bi-fold glass that can close the kitchen. Note: removing the kitchen front wall must be confirmed with HDB / your ID. Power points and aircon trunking are indicative only.
